title: Vuutun Palaa
subtitle: Droid Control Ship
text:
This unit costs 1 resource less to play for each friendly Droid unit.
Each friendly Droid unit may be exhausted to pay costs as if it were a resource.
rules: Vuutun Palaa's second ability is only in effect once Vuutun Palaa is in play. Friendly Droid units can't be exhausted to pay for Vuutun Palaa.
